name: TheBellyDanceDressingRoom
description: TheBellyDanceDressingRoom is an App developed by Laniakea Bellydancer LLC to help dancers around the world to buy and sell dresses in a centralized manner. About me: Laniakea Bellydancer is a Puerto Rican artist based in Maryland, USA. She loves gigging and understands the importance of getting new costumes to support all your performance needs!
